headline: Executive order dealing with the President's Council of Advisors on Science and Technology, a group that advises the White House.
what_it_does: This order concerns the President's Council of Advisors on Science and Technology, a panel of outside experts that gives the President advice on science and technology issues. No summary was provided, so the exact details, such as who serves on the council and what topics it covers, cannot be confirmed from the title alone.

who_it_affects.group: Scientists, engineers, and technology industry leaders
who_it_affects.how: Some may be chosen to serve on the council and advise the President.

who_it_affects.group: White House and federal science officials
who_it_affects.how: They may work with or support the council's advisory work.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 23, 2025; no separate start date is given in the available information.
